highlights: Elara Securities (India) Private Limited Global Markets Research Strong triggers ahead Tata Power’s (TPWR IN) Q2FY27 results were broadly as estimated, with revenue up 26.3% YoY to INR 196.4bn.
EBITDA grew 11.1% YoY to INR 36.7bn, and reported PAT 32.7% YoY to INR 16.5bn.
Its under-construction and pipeline portfolio stood at 4.9GW of renewable capacity and 696MWh of BESS, providing strong medium-term growth visibility.

Financial performance and capex outlook  The company reported its highest-ever quarterly PAT of INR 16.52bn in Q2FY27, registering 33% YoY growth compared with INR 12.45bn in Q2FY26.  H1FY27 PAT increased 22% YoY to INR 30.53bn.
